Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of the microtubule spindle. [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

The completion of transcription: the RNA polymerase pauses, the RNA-DNA hybrid dissociates, followed by the release of the RNA polymerase from its DNA template. [GOC:txnOH, PMID:15020047, PMID:18280161, PMID:30978344]
Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a DNA damage checkpoint. [GOC:obol]
The synthesis of ribosomal RNA (rRNA), any RNA that forms part of the ribosomal structure, from a DNA template. [GOC:jl, ISBN:0198506732]
Creation of the central hole of a tube in an anatomical structure through which gases and/or liquids flow. [GOC:bf]
Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of DNA-templated transcription initiation. [GOC:mah, GOC:txnOH]
The creation of a single organelle from two or more organelles. [GOC:jid]

A transcription initiation process that takes place at a RNA polymerase II gene promoter. Messenger RNAs (mRNA) genes, as well as some non-coding RNAs, are transcribed by RNA polymerase II. [GOC:mah, GOC:txnOH]

The enzymatic release of energy from inorganic and organic compounds (especially carbohydrates and fats) which either requires oxygen (aerobic respiration) or does not (anaerobic respiration). [GOC:das, ISBN:0140513590, ISBN:0198506732]

The initial step of transcription, consisting of the assembly of the RNA polymerase preinitiation complex (PIC) at a gene promoter, as well as the formation of the first few bonds of the RNA transcript. Transcription initiation includes abortive initiation events, which occur when the first few nucleotides are repeatedly synthesized and then released, and ends when promoter clearance takes place. [GOC:jid, GOC:txnOH, PMID:18280161]
The directed movement of a protein to a specific location on or in an organelle. Encompasses establishment of localization in the membrane or lumen of a membrane-bounded organelle. [GOC:mah]

Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the breakdown of a protein or peptide by hydrolysis of its peptide bonds, initiated by the covalent attachment of ubiquitin, and mediated by the proteasome. [GOC:mah]
Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process. [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:BHF, GOC:rl, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:18307834]
Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. [GOC:BHF]
The process in which a relatively unspecialized immature germ cell acquires the specialized features of a mature female gamete. [GOC:go_curators, GOC:mtg_sensu]
Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of DNA-templated transcription initiation. [GOC:mah, GOC:txnOH]
Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. [GOC:BHF]

Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a cAMP (cyclic AMP, adenosine 3',5'-cyclophosphate) stimulus. [GOC:ai]

The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein or peptide covalently tagged with ubiquitin, via the multivesicular body (MVB) sorting pathway; ubiquitin-tagged proteins are sorted into MVBs, and delivered to a lysosome/vacuole for degradation. [GOC:jl, PMID:11511343]

A cellular transport process in which transported substances are moved in membrane-bounded vesicles between endosomal compartments, e.g, between early endosome and sorting endosome. [GOC:dos, PMID:10930469]
